questions: GSM8K train JSONL first 100 rows, in order; user message appends newline + Give only the numerical answer.
fork_checkout: 18df3cef8f61ce371d1958374927b48aba7eafe2 + working tree / remote SM70 build patches
communication: in-process V1 UniProcExecutor on one GPU; fixed host scheduling with native GPUModelRunner and compact large batches
graph: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, enforce_eager=False; per-call dispatch captured during diag
cohorts: contiguous trace order; groups[B]=[cohort_id,slot_order]; route applied per output, first output excluded
decode_scheduling: one step per active request per round, same-round compact large sub-batch. No cross-step batch gate or admission queue. Slot order in trace is logical; native runners map physical rows by request ID.
clock: time.perf_counter on replay process; timestamp at engine-step token commit; synchronize CUDA before/after cohort
timing: decode wall only; warmup is a complete untimed pass of each B; model startup, full-prefix KV priming, prompt prefill and teardown outside decode
free_kv: teacher-force directly into final physical pages on GPU, forget temporary requests without clearing pages, run prompt prefill, expose history through num_computed_tokens. Identical reserved block IDs in exact. No KV transfer in decode.
preemptions: 0 by fixed, exclusive, capacity-checked cohort page assignment
workload_scope: recorded by current deterministic online router on configured Qwen2.5 pair; 85 length stops at 48, 15 natural stops; fixed replay does not measure quality or online queuing
layout: native FP16 [k,151936], stride (151936,1), GPU tensor per nonempty call in actual F row order; warmed iterator consumed once per call

stages.phase1: independent model process for each measurement, one full cohort sweep for warmup; rotate L/F/O left by repeat modulo 3
stages.diagnostic: separate sweep per mode; O heavy_dispatch describes the prepared shape, decoder graph bypassed
